fact: The 2026 budget of the Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital is set at 85.1 billion FCFA in commitment authorisations and 81.06 billion in payment credits, with 20.5 billion for digital economy development and about 38 billion for digital governance and sovereignty, per the National Assembly finance committee report.
title: Budget 2026 : 85,1 milliards FCFA alloués au ministère de la Communication, des Télécommunications et du Numérique
